title: The First Powered Aircraft Flight on Another World
description: NASA's Ingenuity helicopter achieved the first powered, controlled flight on another planet in April 2021. Designed for just five flights over thirty days, the 1.8-kilogram craft completed 72 flights over almost three years on Mars.

shots.narration: This is the first powered, controlled flight on another planet.
Here on Mars, the thin air is about one percent as dense as Earth's at sea level.
To generate lift, the 1.8-kilogram craft spins its 1.2-metre rotors at around 2,400 rpm.
On 19 April 2021, Ingenuity made a 3-metre hover lasting about 39 seconds.
Engineers built the craft for five test flights over 30 days.
Instead, it flew 72 flights over almost three years.
It covered more than 17 km, climbed to 24 metres, and reached 36 km/h.
It carried a small piece of fabric from the Wright brothers' 1903 Flyer.
The mission ended in January 2024 when a rotor blade was damaged on landing.
